correctness.rationale: A biquadratic V4 cover with disjoint 4+4 rational branch sets has genus 5 by Riemann-Hurwitz and character decomposition into elliptic, elliptic and genus-three quotient. The product polynomial is x^7-x. Its trace-zero image over F49 has 42 nonzero squares, hence genus-three N2=92; Weil equality forces (1+7T²)^3. PGL2(F7) sharp 3-transitivity gives cross-ratio orbits of 42 and 28 quartets and complements in the same orbit, yielding 21/14 partitions. Elliptic traces have magnitudes 0/4 from exact F7 Legendre sums. Independent twists produce 84,14,14,28 frequencies. The standalone attached checker exhaustively verifies F7 and F49 direct counts for all 140 marked models; p-rank and elliptic splitting follow from the proven factorization. No finite test is used to infer an infinite statement.

originality.rationale: The asserted new statement is the complete four-Weil-spectrum classification with precise frequencies for all 140 coefficient-marked covers built from the entire P1(F7). Kudo 2024 constructs general disjoint-elliptic Howe plane sextics, without this rational-branch arithmetic table. Howe 2016 treats distinct quotient genera and point-rich constructions. The 2013 F7 Kummer search presents selected many-point records, not this low-F7-count family or F49 zetas. The 120-point genus-five F49 maximum is known. An indexed nearby published-finding corpus F7 Howe pencil has different branch sets. Explicit statement-versus-implication comparisons, not title matching, support best-knowledge originality; exact historical priority remains conditional on unindexed literature.

value.rationale: The locus of all eight F7-rational branch points is canonical and exhausts P1(F7); its complementary 4+4 elliptic branch partitions form a natural finite algebraic-moduli problem. The classification yields four explicit full Weil numerators, exact frequencies, a new 84/56 dichotomy for maximality over F49, and a p-rank jump between 0 and 2, with completely split isogeny factors. This is a meaningful complete geometric-arithmetic classification, not a single arbitrary small computation, and does not re-claim the known existence of maximal genus-five curves.
